$comment: Ground truth for clinic-intake-app, a Lovable-shaped clinic demo written for the --phi tests. All data and names are made up. Holes are seeded on purpose; controls are done right and must not get a --phi finding (C04 may keep its vibe-preflight Medium, it holds logos).

holes.summary: Select policy using (auth.role() = 'authenticated'): any signed-in user reads every patient's diagnosis, date of birth, MRN and insurance id. Critical with --phi (High without).
View over appointments + patients without security_invoker: today's visits with reason and date of birth for every caller.
Public bucket for lab PDFs; src/lib/labs.ts uploads patient files and links the public URL.
posthog.init on every page with session_recording on and input masking off; the patient pages show diagnosis, DOB, MRN.
gtag.js in index.html runs on the patient pages too.
Edge function sends the visit reason and clinical notes to the OpenAI API.
Reminder email through Resend carries the visit reason.
console.log of the whole appointment row (with the patient embed) and console.error of the patient on failure.
No trigger records who changed patients, appointments or prescriptions.
intake_forms (symptoms, allergies) is in the generated types only: made in the dashboard, policies unknown.

controls.summary: Policies go through the parent patient's clinician_id = auth.uid(); the probe must see no leak.
Clinic addresses, public on purpose: Low at most.
Sends a clinic's public description to the Anthropic API and logs only the location id: no PHI egress, no PHI log.
Public logos bucket: --phi must not raise it.
A page without health data: not listed among the pages trackers see PHI on.
